clue.text: Begin to put things in order

definitions.meaning: to start off on a journey or a task
to arrange or lay out items neatly

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to start a journey and to arrange items for display.

clue.text: One embraced by a celebrity in flight

indicators.note: embraced by means held inside, so the letter for one goes within the word for a star

parts.note: a celebrity is a star
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A famous person hugs someone while travelling by plane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in flight' suggests aeroplanes, but a flight is also a run of steps.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight of steps is made up of individual steps, each one being a single tread.

clue.text: Unionist procures grazing land in Arab sultanate

indicators.note: in places the grazing land inside the name of the Arab state

parts.note: Oman is a sultanate on the Arabian peninsula
a range is open land for grazing livestock

explanation.surface: A political loyalist buys pasture in a Gulf state.
explanation.walkthrough: An ORANGEMAN is a member of the Orange Order, a Protestant body in Northern Ireland loyal to the union with Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of the Orange Order are staunch supporters of Northern Ireland's union with Great Britain.

clue.text: The ground to soak up water

annotationWithheld.why: The ground to soak up water (7): no parse found giving TERRAIN; no clue word yields the letters around RAIN or TERRA, so the clue may be misheld
annotationWithheld.clue: The ground to soak up water

clue.text: Declare one's intention to shout abuse

definitions.meaning: saying 'I will pay for the drinks', where to shout is informal for buying a round

explanation.surface: Someone announces a plan to yell insults.
explanation.definitionFit: Split as a promise to buy the round it is one sense; as a verb it means mistreat cruelly.

clue.text: Not dressed for brewing ale there tonight

indicators.note: brewing suggests these letters are being stirred up and mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone skips getting dressed because they are making beer tonight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brewing' rearranges ALE THERE TONIGHT; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means completely naked, wearing no clothing at all.

clue.text: Gave up after being made redundant

definitions.meaning: dismissed from a job because the work is no longer needed

explanation.surface: Someone quit trying once they lost their job.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both desisted from something and dismissed employees for lack of work.

clue.text: Chisel found in French tomb

parts.note: the French word for in is en
a grave is a tomb

explanation.surface: A chisel is discovered inside a French burial vault.
explanation.definitionFit: To engrave is to cut letters into stone or metal, as a carver does with a chisel.

clue.text: The umpire takes aggregate as a result

parts.note: ref, short for referee, is an umpire
ore is a mass of minerals combined in rock, an aggregate

explanation.surface: An official adds up the total score, and so the match is decided.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aggregate' suggests a total score, but here it is a mineral mass.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are connectives meaning consequently or for that reason.

clue.text: A very loud song causes concern

parts.note: ff, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud
an air is a tune or song

explanation.surface: A deafening song worries people.
explanation.definitionFit: An affair is a matter or business, something that is one's concern.

clue.text: A figure that needs altering in shape

indicators.note: putting something in a new shape suggests reworking these letters into a different order

explanation.surface: A diagram needs redrawing.
explanation.definitionFit: A three-sided polygon is a basic geometric figure.

clue.text: Era of violence requires fibre

parts.note: rough as a noun means violent behaviour, as in rough play
an age is an era

explanation.surface: A violent period of history needs a strong fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Dietary fibre is also called bulk, the indigestible part of plant food.

clue.text: Sedative I consumed after work

indicators.note: after places the letters for I and consumed behind the word for work

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work
consumed means ate

explanation.surface: Someone took a calming drug after finishing a job.
explanation.definitionFit: Drugs derived from the poppy dull pain and induce sleep, acting as sedatives.

clue.text: Point of departure for a period in Alabama

parts.note: a term is a period of time, such as a school term
AL is the postal abbreviation for Alabama

explanation.surface: Someone sets off from a place for a stint in a southern US state.
explanation.definitionFit: An airport or bus station building is where journeys start.

clue.text: Will Oriental rugs be put up in a Bedouin dwelling?

indicators.note: in puts the turned rugs and eastern letter inside the dwelling

parts.note: Bedouin nomads live in tents

indicators.note: in a down clue being put up means the word for rugs is read from bottom to top

parts.note: mats are small rugs
E stands for east, the Orient

explanation.surface: Asks whether eastern carpets will be hung in a desert tent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Will' looks like a verb opening a question, but it is the noun for the legal document; 'be put up' works because this is a down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A last will and testament is the legal document disposing of one's estate.

clue.text: Sacrifice made in the interest of self-esteem

parts.note: for means on behalf of
ego is one's sense of self-worth

explanation.surface: Someone gives something up to protect their pride.
explanation.definitionFit: To forgo, also spelt with an extra E, is to do without or give up something.

clue.text: Crumbling terrace in Hyde Park

parts.note: rotten means decayed and crumbling
a terrace is a row of joined houses

explanation.surface: A row of decaying houses stands in a London park.
explanation.walkthrough: ROTTEN ROW is a famous horse-riding track along the south side of Hyde Park in London.
explanation.definitionFit: This sandy bridleway is a well-known feature of the London royal park.

clue.text: Endorsed by Italian male in front of Mr Sherrin

indicators.note: in front of places the Italian title before the broadcaster's first name

parts.note: Sig. abbreviates Signor, the Italian for Mr
Ned Sherrin was a British broadcaster and humorist

explanation.surface: Approved by an Italian man ahead of a TV personality.
explanation.definitionFit: To put one's name to a document is to endorse or approve it.

clue.text: One criminal set up by American agents in Spain

indicators.note: in a down clue set up means the word for criminal is read upwards

parts.note: a lag is a convict
one is the Roman numeral I
the CIA is the US intelligence agency

explanation.surface: A crook framed by US spies in Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' turns LAG to GAL. 'set up' looks like framing.
explanation.definitionFit: Galicia is an autonomous region in the north-west of the Iberian kingdom.

clue.text: Take away pamphlet issued by Employment Dept

indicators.note: issued by puts the issuing department first and the pamphlet after it

parts.note: DE was the Department of Employment in the UK government
a tract is a short pamphlet

explanation.surface: A government department withdraws a leaflet it published.
explanation.definitionFit: To detract is to diminish or subtract from something's value.

clue.text: Not playing, so cancelled the coach

parts.note: a cancelled event is off
a stage is a stagecoach

explanation.surface: Someone is not taking part because the coach trip was called off.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor out of view of the audience is not performing at that moment.

clue.text: Right-wing Conservative is interrupted quickly

indicators.note: interrupted means the letters for conservative and is break into the word for quickly

parts.note: fast means quickly

explanation.surface: A Tory politician gets cut off suddenly.
explanation.definitionFit: Fascism is an authoritarian far-right political ideology.

clue.text: Virtually everyone has some reservation

parts.note: all means everyone
a but is an objection or reservation, as in no ifs or buts

explanation.surface: Almost everybody has a few doubts.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means nearly or almost, as in all but finished.

clue.text: Flower in cathedral city comes from the Orient

indicators.note: in places the flower inside the city's name

parts.note: Ely is a small cathedral city in Cambridgeshire, England
an aster is a daisy-like flower

explanation.surface: A bloom grown in an English city originally came from Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' can be read as a river in crosswords, but here it is a plain bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: An easterly wind blows from the east, which is the Orient.

clue.text: The Lord Lieutenant is in agreement. Cheers!

indicators.note: is in places the lieutenant's abbreviation inside the word for agreement

parts.note: yes expresses agreement
LL abbreviates Lord Lieutenant, a royal representative in a county

explanation.surface: A county dignitary agrees and raises a toast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cheers' looks like a toast, but it means shouts of encouragement.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheers are loud shouts, as are yells from a crowd.

clue.text: Go over the limit

parts.note: reads like speeding or drinking too much, but means intruding beyond a boundary onto someone else's ground

explanation.definitionFit: To intrude gradually beyond proper bounds or onto another's territory.

clue.text: Serial produced in the Middle East

indicators.note: produced suggests the letters of serial are made into something new

explanation.surface: A drama series made in a Middle Eastern country.
explanation.definitionFit: The country lies on the eastern Mediterranean coast in the region named.

clue.text: US trucker finds side-street and about-turns

parts.note: a side is a team

indicators.note: turns means the short word for about is flipped round

parts.note: re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: An American lorry driver discovers a side street and keeps doing U-turns.
explanation.definitionFit: In American usage a lorry driver is so called, after the Teamsters union.

clue.text: Defences we discovered among the hills

indicators.note: among places the letters of we inside the word for hills

parts.note: tors are rocky hills, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: Fortifications were found by us in the hills.
explanation.definitionFit: Towers are tall fortified structures used for defence.
